title: 2003 Brasileirao standings lists 25 teams instead of 24
evidence: queries.py:standings -> standings(2003) returns 25 rows; the 2003 Serie A had 24 clubs. A club survives under two labels because _merge_unstated_states (queries.py:899) only folds an unstated name into a single stated variant, and a mis-aliased spelling escapes dedup. standings(2019) is correct (20 teams, Flamengo 90 pts).
suggestion: Extend team aliasing/dedup so older-season club spellings collapse to one TeamRef, or verify standings row count against expected table size per season.

title: 100 CSV rows silently skipped during load
evidence: loader.py:_RowSkipped increments Dataset.skipped_rows (=100 at load) but nothing surfaces it; _make_match/_goals drop unparseable rows without a log line.
suggestion: Log a warning with the per-file skip counts so data-quality loss is observable rather than silent.

title: FIFA player name lookups miss spec examples due to short-name data
evidence: search_players(name=...) substring-matches player.name (queries.py:996); the FIFA data stores short names ('Gabriel', 'L. Messi') so spec examples like 'Gabriel Barbosa' return nothing. search by 'neymar' works (test_queries.py:167).
suggestion: Document the short-name limitation, or add a fuzzy/last-name match fallback for player search.

title: No top-scorer query (optional capability)
evidence: TASK.md Competition Queries lists 'Top scorers (if inferable from data)' as optional; no goal-scorer data exists in the datasets, so no such tool is provided.
suggestion: None required — correctly omitted; noted for cross-run comparison.
